piece: #proof — the credibility strip and its scroll reveal
biggestGap: Collapse `#proof .proof-list` from its single 353px column with 48px row gaps into a 3-up `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)` row with the values dropped from 47.9px to ~32px so "400+" fits a 117px cell — that turns three stacked announcements that each waste 67–91% of the content band into one 180px-tall set the eye reads at once, and frees the vertical room for the 28–34px section headline the section currently has no room for.
motion: Real, and correctly built. Frame 000 shows only the first item ("12 yrs / Shipping product") at reduced opacity and roughly 18px lower than its settled position; frames 001–005 are pixel-identical and fully settled — the 0.62s reveal completes inside one sampling interval, so 5 of 6 frames show a finished state. Scrubbing confirms the mechanism: opacity 0→1 plus translateY(18px)→0, transition-property `opacity, transform` only, duration 0.62s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); no re-animation when scrolled back to y=0 (is-in persists, opacity stays 1); prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses duration to 1e-05s with no transform and all three items already in at y=0; will-change is correctly released to `auto` after is-in lands. The failure is not the animation, it is that the coded 72ms/144ms sibling stagger never executes — the three items cross their observer thresholds at scrollY 50–75, 175–200 and 300–325, so item 1 is fully at opacity 1.00 by y=175, 25px of scroll before item 2 even begins.

violations.rule: 1.1 one idea per viewport — a screenshot at any depth has a single obvious subject
violations.measured: Section box is 393x473.3 CSS px inside an 852px viewport (55%), so it can never own a screen. proof-viewport-000.png holds five competing zones at once: the hero's accent Email CTA (the only saturated colour on screen), three co-equal 47.946px/weight-680 numbers, the "SELECTED WORK" eyebrow, the top of the Canvas Editor card, and the fixed bottom dock.

violations.rule: 1.3 stagger between siblings 60–90ms; more than 120ms reads as slow
violations.measured: Coded transition-delay is 0s / 0.072s / 0.144s, but each .proof-item has its own observer: item 1 gains is-in between scrollY 50 and 75, item 2 between 175 and 200, item 3 between 300 and 325 — ~125 scroll px apart. Item 1 measured opacity 1.00 at y=175 while items 2 and 3 are still 0.00. The declared 72ms stagger is dead code; the user sees three unrelated one-at-a-time fades.

violations.rule: 1.2 hierarchy comes from size and weight jumps — heading levels
violations.measured: The section's only heading, h2.eyebrow.proof-eyebrow, is 13px/590 — 0.76x the 17px body it introduces, an inverted heading. The 28–34px section-headline level SPEC 1.2 defines is entirely absent, so the loudest element in the section (47.946px/680) is a bare digit with no claim attached to it: "12 yrs / Shipping product" is a label, not a statement.

violations.rule: 1.4 optical alignment beats mathematical alignment; 1.2 type does the work
violations.measured: Content band is 353px (x 20→373). Measured ink right edges: "12 yrs" 120.5px, "400+" 136.6px, "8" 51.5px — the number rows use 28.5%, 33.0% and 8.9% of the band, leaving 67–91% dead on every row; the widest ink in the whole section is "Enterprise brands served" at 230px, still 40.5% short. Digit-run widths 63.1 / 94.6 / 31.5px are a 3x spread, left-aligned with no right edge, rule or shared column to close them. font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is declared on all three values but buys nothing in a single-column stack (grid-template-columns: 353px).
violations.where: ul.proof-list (display:grid, grid-template-columns:353px, gap:48px) and its three p.proof-value.num

violations.rule: 1.2 type scale — levels must be nameable and adjacent jumps >= 1.25x
violations.measured: Four sizes measured: 47.946 / 24 / 17 / 13px, ratios 2.00x, 1.41x, 1.31x — all pass 1.25x. But span.proof-unit at 24px/510 sits below the 28–34px section-headline band and above body, a fifth size belonging to no named level in SPEC 1.2.

evidence: Captured myself via `node harness/shot.mjs proof captures/critic-r1/proof http://127.0.0.1:4173/` at 393x852 DPR3, 4x CPU throttle. Opened with the Read tool: /home/user/cartridge/cv-site/captures/critic-r1/proof/proof-element.png, proof-viewport-000.png, and all six frames proof-motion-000.png through proof-motion-005.png in order. Numerically confirmed with three throttled Playwright probes against the running page: full computed-style dump of every #proof descendant (bg rgb(8,9,10); section padding 0px 20px 80px; ul grid gap 48px, grid-template-columns 353px; values 47.946px/680/-1.82195px ls/50.8228px lh = 1.06; labels 17px/400/21.76px; eyebrow 13px/590/1.105px ls; secondary rgb(144,150,161) = 6.70:1 on rgb(8,9,10), primary rgb(247,248,248) = ~18:1; document.scrollWidth 393; zero elements in the section carry any background, border, shadow or gradient; zero accent hues; harness reported taps: [] so there is nothing interactive to fail the 44px floor); a 0–500px scroll scrub logging is-in and opacity per item at 25px steps, in both normal and prefers-reduced-motion contexts; and Range.getBoundingClientRect ink measurement of every text node.
